glosses: Of or relating to Myanmar, Burmese.
A country in Southeast Asia. Official name: Republic of the Union of Myanmar. Capital: Naypyidaw. Also known as Burma (which was formerly the official name).

examples.text: The watchdog group Global Witness recently found that Chinese companies with links to Myanmar rare-earth supplies have listed as customers Ford Motor, Hyundai Motor, Siemens, Tesla, Vestas Wind Systems, Volkswagen and others.

glosses: The Sino-Tibetan official language of the country of Myanmar.
The script in which the Myanmar language is written.
